ShortDescription.Value: American-style highway toll plazas: booths, canopy and slowing traffic that pays a toll.

Publish.LongDescription:
Toll Plaza adds American-style highway toll plazas to Cities: Skylines II. Pick a plaza with 2 to 6 booths from the Toll Plazas tab in the Roads menu and drop it on a highway. Vehicles slow through the booths and pay a toll that goes straight to the city treasury, with a Toll Plazas line in the budget screen.
- Cash and E-Toll lanes, with closable booths and animated gate arms - Live roof, toll-rate and speed signs that follow your settings - A control panel with city totals (this month, last month, all time) and a plaza panel for per-plaza rates - An Options page for plaza prices and the rates a new city starts with, plus buttons to reset a city's toll data - Toll data is stored outside the save file and written crash-safe
Note1: I have tested this mod with several toll booth mods available with no visible issues whatsoever. However I can't confirm if other mods of this type have issues on their end.
Note2: I haven't noticed any performance degradation while using this mod with up to 8 individual toll plazas placed in various sections on my testing map (from population 6k-65k currently.).
Note3: I haven't found a reliable way to make cars stop making last minute lane change decisions before entering a booth. The only way that was a compromise was to give vehicles enough time to slow down in stages before they drive through a booth which does reduce, but won't completely eliminate the games behavior of vehicles making last minute decisions on which lane they need to be in before switching lanes.
*Note3A: I kinda like vehicles making late lane change decisions sometimes, as it reminds me of the morons in New Jersey who can't decide if they need to be in EZ-Pass only lanes or lanes that accept cash and EZ-Pass. It's quite humorous watching vehicles stop to a halt in the middle of the toll plaza causing traffic backups. :-)
Source code: https://github.com/neosoft-nvm/TollPlaza (MIT license).
Note4: Just have FUN and play around with it if you'd like. If this mod fits your design and functionality motif then feel free to use it however you like. If you like it and would like to see more things that I haven't had the time to implement, or haven't thought about, feel free to drop a comment. I plan on releasing updates and new features for as long as it makes the game a little more immersive and enjoyable for me.
Thanks AGAIN to the modding community for just being so awesome and a great source of modding expertise. :) Their open source mods and shared notes taught me a lot: Road Rules (willmakesrandomshit), Tollbooth Highways (Javapower77), Traffic (krzychu124) and Extra Assets Importer (AlphaGaming7780). No code was copied from them.

ChangeLog.Value: 0.1.0 - First release. Toll plazas with 2 to 6 booths and a canopy; vehicles slow down and pay a toll that goes to the city treasury. Control panel with city totals (this month, last month, all time), plaza info panel with per-plaza rates, live toll and speed signs, animated gate arms, cash and E-Toll lanes, closable booths. Options page for plaza prices and starting toll rates, with buttons to reset a city's toll data. Toll data is kept outside the save file and written crash-safe.
